title: Restore a NotReady Node
prompt:
Node `node01` is reporting `NotReady` and scheduled Pods on it cannot become Ready.

Perform the following tasks:
1. Diagnose `node01` and restore it to `Ready`.
2. Do not restart or reboot any other node.

checks.failure_hint: Check `systemctl status kubelet` on node01 and start the service.
The kubelet unit is inactive — start it with systemctl.

reference_solution:
Start the kubelet service on node01.
```bash
ssh cka-node01 'sudo systemctl start kubelet'
```
hints: Check `k get nodes` and SSH into `node01` to inspect node services with `sudo systemctl status kubelet`.
Restart the kubelet systemd unit on `node01` (`sudo systemctl start kubelet`) and verify node Ready status.
fast_solution_commands: ssh cka-node01 'sudo systemctl start kubelet && sudo systemctl is-active kubelet'
